title: Project Sovereign Beta Ascension
final_sha_note: This is the implementation commit. A following commit only records this SHA. Use the pull request head for the branch tip.
independent_review_note: The implementing agent wrote the tests. PR #170 CI was green for that same author's branch. That is not an independent witness. Do not merge on this report.
schema_migration: None. SQLite tables are unchanged. Receipt v2 is a new signed document shape. Legacy rows are read and labeled LEGACY_METADATA_UNBOUND. They are not rewritten.
implemented: Receipt v2 binds run_id, created_at, and receipt_binding under the MAC and the content hash
Legacy receipts still verify and are not silently upgraded
Downgrade, column swap, and identity stripping fail verification
Duplicate invoices withhold dollars when no precedence evidence exists
Orphan, duplicate, and rate-mismatch invoices do not also add their cash gap into the total
Partial payments, overpayments, settled-open invoices, and unresolved split-or-duplicate payments
Synthetic pilot covers the same payment cases and does not book reversals
CSV and JSON ingestion with SHA-256, tenant, row provenance, and formula neutralization
PDF and spreadsheet bytes are rejected rather than parsed by an uninstalled tool
36-month synthetic golden audit with an independent dollar manifest
In-memory incremental monitoring that refuses conflicting ids and never confirms recovery
Dashboard copy shows receipt binding, withheld dollars, qualification, and XAELI's advisory limit
not_implemented: OCR, PDF, image, and spreadsheet extraction
Live local or remote model inference
Equipment-hour, personnel-hour, standby, and contract-revision workflows beyond the existing rate window
A document archive of 36 months of files; the golden audit is typed synthetic rows

end_to_end_audit.limit: Typed rows only. This is not a scanned-document audit and is not a claim of field accuracy.
